title: DIS storm protection absent: no 1-per-10s rate limit; C windowing interval caller-set, Rust/Python have none (draft 6.4, R-RPL-021)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 6.4 — 'Rate limit DIS transmission (max 1 per 10 seconds); Ignore rapid DIS from same source'. Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-021, not-implemented (the specific contract), confidence high.
Evidence: the 10 s constant appears in no stack. C has generic receiver-side windows (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dis.c:107-142 — multicast/unicast not_before, COALESCED/RATE_LIMITED outcomes per include/lichen/rpl_dis.h:26-34) but the interval is caller-configured response_interval_ms and no production caller sets 10 000 (test uses 4000 ms, lichen/tests/rpl_dis/main.c:42). Rust handle_authenticated_dis (lichen-rpl/src/dis.rs) has no rate limiting (tests pass 10_000 only as a timestamp); node TX path rpl_stack/transmit.rs:135-157 unthrottled. Python rpl/dis.py:60-108 none.
Suggested placement: define the rate-limit constant (10 s) in constants.toml [rpl] + all three stacks; C: default response_interval_ms to 10000; Rust/Python: add receiver-side coalescing mirroring the C outcomes.
